column1: # Labeled cases for scripts/jev-triage.sh --replay-surface, built from capability signals, audit issues, and saved vendor pages.
# yes: the excerpt adds, removes, renames, or alters a project-scoped config surface. no: UI, CLI UX, models, packaging, or user-level changes.

column3: Pin the default model for this repo.
Set triggers: [user] to prevent the agent from invoking a skill on its own.
permissionMode controls approval behavior for Subagent tool calls.
File-based agents can define lifecycle hooks that run at specific points during execution.
Add an executable .agents/setup shell script at the repository root.
A Markdown agent can list hook files in its front matter with a hooks: entry.
Setting mcpServers: [] excludes every MCP server, even globally configured ones.
Create a file named .geminiignore in the root of your project directory.
Added "attribution": false in settings.json to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions
channel_enabled: "Enable this MCP server as a channel (equivalent to --channels)"
A disabled server remains configured but is not used by Copilot. This setting persists across sessions.
A new "Toggle Between Light/Dark Themes" command flips the theme without a trip to Settings.
Refreshed the model catalog: still 209 providers, 6,188 to 6,237 models. The Cline Pass tier gains cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-flash and cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-pro.
The Conversation API returns skill loads as read_skill actions.
GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna now support a 1M token context window, up from 272K, in the Kiro IDE, CLI, and Web.
